mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.role_code=ur.role_code WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY rp.permission_code
SELECT r.name FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN admin_role r ON r.code=ur.role_code WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.enabled=TRUE ORDER BY r.code
